pages.title: Grains
pages.text: Grains are staple foods that form the backbone of any diet. $(#e05252)Penalty:$() reduced hunger restoration when depleted. $(#52c252)Bonus:$() faster experience gain when maintained. Bread is your most reliable source.

pages.title: Grains — Baked Goods
pages.text: Pumpkin pie and other baked goods also count toward Grains. They provide higher nutrition values than plain bread, making them worth crafting once you have a reliable pumpkin and sugar supply.
